changelog: Vortex v5.2.0: New Quick Panel overlay (CTRL+SHIFT+F8 by default, configurable) for switching accounts and applying crosshair codes without opening the full app - a separate floating window, not drawn over the game. Fixes two real region-detection bugs (accounts were being stamped with the wrong or a guessed region that never got corrected) and a stats cache bug where switching accounts quickly could show one account's stats under another's name.
